text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High model quality regression detected for tenant `sable-prod` (VPC/Dedicated pool). Severity: P2. Trigger: automated evals show BLEU drop ~18% and increased hallucination rate. Logs aggregated in /var/logs/incidents/1719000000.

oncall-anna: I have the alert, jumping in now. tagging SRE and runtime.

sre-miguel: I'm awake, pulling traces. can someone confirm impact: wrong semantics only or 5xxs too?

support-alex: No 5xxs — requests are returning, but responses are low-quality/unsafe for the customer's compliance bar. Customer reported via support ticket #SB-4021.

account-psm-lara: Heads up — Sable is in their compliance review tomorrow, they flagged this already. Need a mitigation ASAP, even if temporary.

eng-runtime-jin: Noted. Initial hypothesis: a recent model rollout (v3-beta-prune) hit sable's dedicated shard. We have safe variant available `v2.8-qat-safe`.

oncall-anna: Ok plan proposal: 1) Pin sable-prod to `v2.8-qat-safe` as an override 2) Open a canary to verify 3) Notify customer and follow up. Any objections?

customerops-bob: +1 to pin. We should also capture produced completions for audit for the next 24h.

eng-runtime-jin: I'll apply the tenant override. Payload (runtime-config API):

``` 
POST /runtime/admin/tenant_override
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tenant_id": "sable-prod",
  "override": {
    "model_family": "open-llama",
    "model_version": "v2.8-qat-safe",
    "reason": "emergency-quality-fallback",
    "expires_at": "2026-03-15T15:30:00Z"
  }
}
```

sre-miguel: Before applying, confirm which pool the tenant is on to avoid routing mismatch. `describe-tenant sable-prod`?

eng-runtime-jin: They are on dedicated pool `ded-nyc-12`, model variants present: v3-beta-prune (quant), v2.8-qat-safe (fp16-quant). Routing is compatible.

oncall-anna: Go ahead Jin. Make sure to enable prefix/KV cache warmup after flip. Add a canary flag: `canary=5%` for 5 minutes.

eng-runtime-jin: Applying now...

incident-bot: system: runtime-config-change applied by eng-runtime-jin at 1719000098. Change id: devops-override-1719000098.

eng-runtime-jin: Started canary: 5% traffic to v2.8-qat-safe for sable-prod. Warming KV cache (preload keys from last 1h).

support-alex: Monitoring customer ticket — messaging them we are rolling back to a verified safe variant; will update in 10m. Suggested message: "We've routed your requests to a verified safe model variant while we investigate. No downtime, brief quality change expected."

account-psm-lara: Good. Please include ETA for full rollback/rollback window.

oncall-anna: Monitoring metrics: perceptual-quality score (internal), hallucination rate, avg latency. If perceptual-quality > prior baseline in 10m, scale canary to 100%.

sre-miguel: I'm watching error budgets and memory footprints. No spikes in OOM or 5xx during canary so far.

incident-bot: metric-update: perceptual-quality for sable-prod increased from 0.62 to 0.89 at 1719000210. Latency +12ms median.

oncall-anna: Looks good. Jin, please roll to 100% and keep override in place until we have root cause and a plan to re-onboard v3.

eng-runtime-jin: Rolling to 100%...

incident-bot: system: runtime-config-change applied by eng-runtime-jin at 1719000275. Change id: devops-override-1719000275. Canary complete.

support-alex: Notifying customer now with update and asking for any regressions.

account-psm-lara: Sent. Customer replied: "Thanks — quality looks better. Please keep us posted on RCA and timeline to restore newer model."

customerops-bob: Action items: capture sample outputs (s3://redwood-incidents/sable/1719000000/) for 30 days, create a follow-up ticket for model owner to validate v3 safety regression, and schedule a war room w/ model team.

eng-runtime-jin: Created follow-up: ENG-INC-6742 (model rollback + safety eval). Also, we've set the override TTL to 48h and disabled automated rollout for sable-prod.

oncall-anna: Great. For postmortem: include timeline of rollout, automated eval thresholds, and add a safety gate to block v3 variants for tenants with compliance flag unless gated by manual canary.

sre-miguel: Agreed. I'll add monitoring alert to notify if any tenant-specific perceptual-quality drops >10% post-rollout.

incident-bot: incident: status=mitigated, severity=P2, incident_id=INC-2026-171900. Started=1719000000, mitigated=1719000280.

oncall-anna: Thanks team. Handing off to Jin + model owners for RCA. If anything regresses, re-pager. :white_check_mark:

eng-runtime-jin: Leaving notes in the change: `override: sable-prod -> v2.8-qat-safe, reason=emergency-quality-fallback, change_ids=[devops-override-1719000098,devops-override-1719000275]`.

support-alex: Closing customer-facing loop. Ticket updated.

account-psm-lara: I'll prep an exec-friendly summary for Sable.

customerops-bob: Filing postmortem draft under docs/incidents/INC-2026-171900.md and pinging model team.

oncall-anna: Great work everyone.
